title: Blues Run the Game: The Strange Tale of Jackson C. Frank
description: In the mid-60s, Jackson C. Frank released a masterpiece of folk music in Britain. This young American songwriter was close to Simon & Garfunkel, Bert Jansch, John Renbourn, Al Stewart, Roy Harper, Sandy Denny and many others. All of them were influenced by this enigmatic and tormented character. Shortly after the release of his unique album, he disappeared. Wrecked by a series of tragedies in his life, he chose to cut himself off from the world and got trapped by his demons. Still today, young musicians like John Mayer, Laura Marling or Robin Pecknold perform Blues Run the Game. This documentary follows Jackson C. Frank's footsteps to unknot the threads of a tragic destiny. Facts and songs don't express everything about a man, a personality. Who was Jackson C. Frank? Who remembers him? Where to find meaning, or even light, in a life as dark as his?

title: Murder of Innocence
description: Newlywed Laurie Wade's deeply-rooted psychotic behavior shatters her marriage, and eventually her entire life. She goes from brief "short circuits" to overtly murderous behavior. The film never tries to explain the cause of her mental collapse, except for a hint or two, but instead takes the viewer into her frightening state of mind.

title: [ENG DUB] Against the Odds: Cici's Second Act
description: In her past life, Cici was killed by her husband, Yates. However, she miraculously reincarnated and returned to the day she first met Yates's family. This time, Cici decisively chose Yates' uncle, Benson. Despite rumors claiming that Benson was sterile, Cici found herself pregnant with triplets and was spoiled by Benson!

title: No Sword Can Rival Hers
description: At five, she slew a dragon—then hid her sword for thirteen years. Old law: women who wield swords are crippled or killed. Her aunt won a duel disguised as a man; she was broken and jailed for thirteen years. Now her family falls. Vera disguises as Gavin, sweeps the royal trials, and when orcs storm the capital, she kills the Orc King. The old law dies. Girls can wield swords openly—and Vera frees her aunt.

title: Salad Days
description: "Salad Days: A Decade of Punk in Washington, DC (1980-90)" examines the early DIY punk scene in the Nation's Capital. It was a decade when seminal bands like Bad Brains, Minor Threat, Government Issue, Scream, Void, Faith, Rites of Spring, Marginal Man, Fugazi, and others released their own records and booked their own shows-without major record label constraints or mainstream media scrutiny. Contextually, it was a cultural watershed that predated the alternative music explosion of the 1990s (and the industry's subsequent implosion). Thirty years later, DC's original DIY punk spirit serves as a reminder of the hopefulness of youth, the power of community and the strength of conviction.

title: Hear Me, Mommy? Now Let's Get Rich!
description: The Goddess of Wealth, Ann Lowe, is reincarnated as Eva Shaw’s unborn daughter, whom she is carrying in her womb. Ann soon learns that the powerful Lowe family and her father, Cory Lowe, plan to cast Eva aside because she is carrying a daughter. From within the womb, Ann guides Eva to build a fortune in stocks and shine at auctions. Mother and daughter join forces to defeat her biased father and rise to become the world’s top billionaires.

title: Love, Lost and Found（DUBBED）
description: Mia Sanders, a kind-hearted young woman, has been labeled as a jinx by her family from the day she was born. Not only does her father treat her as if she's invisible, but even the household servants look down on her. In stark contrast, her twin sister, Molly Sanders, is the favored one. Molly subjects Mia to ceaseless mistreatment and oppression, and Mia can only endure it. She holds onto the belief that she can escape this life once she grows up and moves out.

title: Swallowed Star S1-S2
description: This series follows the protagonist, Luo Feng, in a post-apocalyptic world full of intelligent Monsters, as he becomes a warrior (superhuman) and gradually improves by overcoming various difficulties.

title: Fini le Lèche-Bottes, Vive la Richesse ( Doublé )
description: Pendant 3 ans, Loïc Gaillard court après Rosa Lecomte, la star de la fac, qui finit par le larguer sans pitié. Dans sa détresse, il active un « système de larbin ». Mais Loïc, qui en a assez de ramper, décide d'exploiter un bug du système pour empocher d'énormes sommes d'argent, et pour s'acheter tout ce qu'il désire. Convaincu que ce choix égoïste le condamnera à finir seul, il finit par comprendre : quand on investit en soi, les beautés se pressent naturellement !

title: Stellar Transformation S1-S6
description: In order to gain the respect of his father, a kid without innate ability to practice internal techniques, resolutely chooses to follow the more difficult path of practicing external techniques. Will he be able to gain his father's respect?

title: Till I See You
description: Song Yi, a wealthy young man raised in Japan, travels to Northern China in search of answers about his father's past and unexpectedly becomes Xu Feiyu's temporary caregiver. Recovering from eye surgery with his eyes still covered in bandages, Feiyu slowly lowers his guard under Song Yi's domineering yet tender care. Before they can truly "see" each other, they have already fallen in love.

title: Mudhal Kanave
description: The movie begins in Kanyakumari where Hari (Vikranth) settles down as painter for his livelihood. He comes across Jennifer (Honey Rose) and gets attracted by her. A sequence of events reveals that she is a married woman. She is the wife of David (Yugendhran) in the same village. Hari opens his heart to his employer (Manivann). A flashback reveals that Hari and Jennifer had been in love for a long time. A sequence of events leaves Jennifer mistaking Hari for no fault of him. She gets married and settles down in Kaniyakumari. Hari is hopeful that he would woo back Jennifer. The rest of the event is all but how Jennifer and Hari get united.

title: Midnight Breaks
description: When sweet-voiced Cassie (Dawn Hope) of unsigned reggae act Midnight is offered a lucrative deal to join successful group Breaks by record company rep Billy (Toyah Willcox), her bandmate boyfriend Tyron (Letts) is less than thrilled.

title: Sleep With My Husband's Brother
description: After her parents were murdered, she married into the enemy's family under a false name to protect her unconscious brother and find out the truth. An unexpected misflirtation accidentally provoked the vicious second master who fell in love with her at first sight.

title: A Love Paid in Tears
description: After returning to her biological family, Jane Gray does everything she can for them, only to be set up by her brother to sleep with a stranger. However, by chance, she spends the night with Hans Bale, the CEO of Bale Corp, and soon marries him despite only knowing him for days.

title: Rooftops
description: A touring musician returns home to spend time with old friends and an old flame for a day. Just as times begin to feel right again, she has to reckon with leaving again.

title: [Doublé] Le Dragon Furtif Est De Retour
description: Quentin Fèvre, le Roi des Mercenaires, est las des conflits. Un simple contrôle de sécurité révèle son identité stupéfiante. Alors qu'un contrat de mariage est prévu avec Céline Seguin, héritière de la famille Seguin, Quentin découvre que la jeune femme est entourée de dangers. Il utilise ses propres méthodes pour aider Céleste Seguin, mais se retrouve entraîné malgré lui dans une conspiration bien plus vaste. Face à chaque piège, Quentin Fèvre riposte, surmonte les périls et parvient à se sortir de situations difficiles.

title: Love Unexpected
description: A sweet love story between an emotionally detached CEO and a female bodyguard who is full of empathy.

title: A Twist of Fate
description: Laurel York has been secretly loving Sean Leon since childhood but never dared to approach him due to her insecurities about her appearance. As adults, a twist of fate brought them together, but Laurel, fearing rejection, chose to hide her identity. Unexpectedly, someone else impersonated her, leading to a series of misunderstandings. Fortunately, the two ultimately overcame the obstacles and misunderstandings, finding happiness together.

title: My Annoying Roommate
description: In the second semester of her junior year, 17-year-old Su Qiao welcomed her new desk mate, the "big celebrity" Lin Zilu. However, his appearance immediately brought misfortune to Su Qiao.

title: One Punch Man vs. Mosquito
description: Is One-Punch Man unbeatable or did a mosquito expose him? The unending battle between man and bug rages on.

title: A Summertime Drug
description: Stand up Comedian Louis C vents about his childhood, adulthood and relentless failures with relationships. A Summertime Drug was filmed during back to back nights for 2 sold out crowds at The Stage Door in Elko, NV.

title: Veil of Vengeance: The Woman in Disguise
description: After her marriage to Shawn Holt is destroyed by Sherry Lind, Penny Lind loses the family she tried so hard to protect. Seeking revenge, she transforms into Xandra Ford and returns to make Sherry pay for her actions. However, Zack Green mistakenly believes Xandra is responsible for Penny’s disappearance and stands in her way.

title: RICH GIRL REBORN:GOING CRAZY FOR LOVE
description: Choi Cheong-yeon and Kim Myeong-nam are lovers whose relationship is tested time and again. A crisis at her family’s company and a web of complicated relationships leave Cheong-yeon struggling. Though Myeong-nam remains devoted to her, misunderstandings and sinister schemes drive them apart. Caught in the plots of Park Yong-jun and Choi Hyo-jin, the couple endure countless hardships, with Myeong-nam even suffering a life-threatening injury. Yet their love and trust help them expose the conspiracies and overcome every obstacle. Myeong-nam thwarts Yong-jun’s plans and saves the Choi Group, while Cheong-yeon clears her family’s name. Finally united, they prove that true love can conquer even the greatest challenges.

title: The Hunt of the Son of Beast
description: Andrew, David and his friends are taking a vacation to Kings Island when something strange and mysterious is happening and it's returning.

title: Perfect and Casual [Hindi]
description: It tells the romantic story between Zhang Sinian, the aloof and monastic "Mr. Perfect" and Yun Shu, the laid-back and cheerful "Miss Almost".

title: One fateful Night with My Neighbor Boss（DUBBED）
description: After a one-night stand with Kim Tae-on, Yoon Ha-jung gives birth to twins. However, her ruthless stepsister, Yoon Se-ra, secretly steals one of the babies and claims the child as her own. She becomes Kim Tae-on's fiancee through deception. Six years later, Yoon Ha-jung returns under a new identity—the famous perfumer, Arta.

title: Secret Baby, Billionaire Daddy(Dubbed)
description: To investigate his mother's death, Mason becomes a taxi driver and has a one-night stand with beautiful CEO Victoria. Years later, she returns with their daughter and proposes to him. When she's humiliated at a banquet, Mason's billionaire father steps in, revealing his real identity.

title: The Eight-Year-Old Patriarch Return of the Supreme Mage
description: Supreme Mage Merlin wakes after a century, turns the Hell King into a goat mount, and returns home. His family is being destroyed by the Malphas family. He lifts his sister’s curse, defeats the three-headed hellhound, and begins his counterattack.

title: Legend of Yun Xi
description: A young naive girl skilled in magical medicine and poisons meets cruel power struggle, villains, friends and love.

title: Secretary Ye's Attached Boss
description: A girl, solely chosen as the personal secretary because of her resemblance to the CEO's first love, spent five years by his side. She believed her own love story had finally arrived, only to discover that he was about to get engaged...

title: Golden Dragon Mother's Rampage
description: Golden Dragon Mother's Rampage

title: Werewolf King's Hidden Heir
description: Human girl Nellie, drunk, stumbles into werewolf king Clifford's territory, has a one-night stand with him, and flees. Five years later, she applies to be his family doctor for her sick son Brady—only to discover her employer is the man from that night. Recognizing her, Clifford relentlessly pursues her while Brady's werewolf blood awakens. Werewolf nobles repeatedly frame Brady as a "cursed child" and try to kill him, but Clifford protects his family. At their wedding, he exposes the conspiracy and proves Brady's pure lineage. Nellie accepts his proposal, Brady gains the pack's acceptance, and the three live happily ever after.

title: The Land of Warriors
description: After the finals, Tang San parts ways with friends for five years of training. He reunites them to form the Tang Sect and confront Bibi Dong's sinister ambitions, protecting the Douluo Continent.

title: Mecha Underdog
description: Jax Thorne, the legendary 5-time mecha champion, was betrayed and discarded by his club for being "too old." Left penniless, he’s taken in by Amy, the beautiful owner of a failing gym, hiding his identity as a humble mechanic. But when ruthless rivals push Amy to the brink, the King must rise. With his secret SSS-class mecha, Phoenix, Jax is ready to crush his betrayers and claim his queen!

title: Only Tamed for You
description: Joan White, heir to the White Group, was betrayed by her sister and fiancé, left for dead at sea. She survived, but with the mind of a child. Taken in by the mysterious Tommy Frim, they married in a flash. He doted on her, and love quietly bloomed.But after a blow to the head at a party,Joan's memories return. With her past restored, will her revenge begin?

title: Rejected Siren, Chosen by the Prince
description: Voiceless Alicia trusts Rayne, unaware she's a pawn in his revenge. Forced to marry the "Mad Prince" Kane, she's framed and tortured as Rayne watches. Her hidden bloodline awakens. At Rayne's engagement, she exposes the lies, leaving proudly with Kane. Kane isn't mad—just tormented by the sea's cries—and together they heal. Consumed by obsession, Rayne wages war for her but fails. He's imprisoned; Shelly ruined. Voice restored, Alicia guards the deep sea with Kane.

title: Married to a Billionaire in Disguise
description: On the eve of her wedding, Emily Green catches her fiancé cheating. In a fit of anger, she impulsively marries a handsome beggar she meets by chance. What starts as a simple life with a doting husband takes a shocking turn when she discovers her "beggar" husband is actually a billionaire CEO!

title: The Princess's Gambit
description: A former princess enters an arranged marriage with a prime minister. Amidst political turmoil, she navigates loyalty conflicts, vengeance, and love while he conceals patriotic motives behind his ambitions.

title: Vengeance in Disguise: Walk in Shadows, Strike in Fire
description: Victor Vance, once the sole heir of a prestigious family, became the only survivor after rivals slaughtered the family to seize their heirloom. Ten years later, Victor returns seeking revenge. His childhood love, Viola Joyner, has never forgotten him. She buried his parents and visits their grave every year. While avenging his family, Victor conceals his identity to remain by her side, but ultimately, to protect her, he is forced to reveal it.

title: Blossoms of Power
description: The sole survivor of a bloodshed, Qingzhi Gu awakens under a new identity as Xihe Shen, the Princess of the Northwest. Once a proud and spirited rose of the frontier, she has now transformed into a cold, calculating figure, determined to seize control of her destiny and dominate the game of power. Crown Prince Huayong Xiao, frail in body but razor-sharp in mind, sees through the treacherous currents of the court. As their fates intertwine, they grow closer, joining forces to command the winds of destiny.

title: The Heir
description: In the middle of Ming Dynasty, a tribute ink case broke the long-standing pattern of Huizhou ink industry, and Li Mo, a century-old family of ink making, fell to the altar. Li Mo's vitality was greatly damaged, and the ink industry of the Luo family rose, and the scenery was no two after Li Mo. Finally, due to the involvement of the government, the family was also destroyed. As time goes by, Li Zhen (Yang Zi is acted the role of), the eighth female of the Li clan, resolutely embarked on the road of making ink to solve the livelihood, and became the dark horse of Huizhou ink industry with talent and efforts. Luo Wenqian, the second son of the Locke family (Han Dongjun is acted the role of) to restore the layout of the family business, to stir up the pattern of Huizhou ink industry. They two people and ink industry upstart field ink family battle of wits and courage, Li Mo back to the top. In the face of the challenges of overseas ink industry, Li Zhen collected the essence of Huizhou ink industry, produced top ink products, and won the reputation of "the first ink in the world" for Huizhou ink. Li Zhen and Luo Wenqian finally got married and worked together to promote the passing down of Huizhou ink to the world.

title: Sniper Butterfly
description: When Jin Cen falls into a low point in her life, she receives a call for help from Wu Li, a rural boy she once supported. Wu Li's spirit of self-reliance moves Jin Cen, prompting her to bring Wu Li, who is about to drop out of school and has no one to rely on, to the city for education. Six years later, Wu Li, now a successful professional, returns to the city and reunites with Jin Cen due to work. While he doesn't mention the past on the surface, his feelings of love remain deep inside. Encouraged by Wu Li's sincerity and bravery, Jin Cen chooses to respond to love truthfully.

title: Quantum G-d
description: Quantum G-d is a 96 pages script and a presentation deck, for a science documentary, written, from the scientific optics, by scientists from the California Institute of Technology, Caltech, listed as the most important institute of technology in the world, and one of the main universities along with Harvard, MIT and Oxford. Throughout the script, the physicists formulate questions and provide the answers through different professional perspectives according to each area of study. This is accompanied with a series of mind blowing, never before seen animations that will be used in schools to teach quantum physics for an entire generation. The script, which includes the pointed questions and the novel animations, will challenge the top minds in theoretical physics to re-evaluate our ideas of how the universe works through the lens of quantum entanglement. One of the writers serves as the manager for Caltech's Institute for Quantum Information and Matter, and he was a scientific consultant in Marvel's blockbuster movies, including Ant Man, Spider Man Homecoming, Ant Man and the Wasp, Infinity War, Captain Marvel, Doctor Strange, Avengers: Endgame and Fantastic Voyage (dir: Guillermo del Toro, prod: James Cameron). The narrative was constructed with the help of another scientist, a cell and molecular pathologist and research associate at the Doheny Eye Institute in Los Angeles, who co-wrote the viral shorts films, "Anyone Can Quantum" and "Quantum is Calling" which featured Stephen Hawking, Paul Rudd, Keanu Reeves, Zoe Saldana, Simon Pegg and John Cho respectively.

title: The Hero of Submarine D-2
description: Lieutenant Commander Colton, U.S.N., is in love with Caroline Austen, daughter of a prominent political power in Washington. Colton has a rival in James Archer, a journalist of prominence, unscrupulous and secretly in league with the Ruanian Ambassador, who is endeavoring to obtain for his country inside information as to the United States naval resources. Gilman Austen, Caroline's brother, receives an appointment to the Naval Academy. He is much in love with Ethel McMasters, daughter of a superintendent, and pays so much attention to her that his term marks in navigation are so low as to preclude his passing the semi-annual examination. He is told of this by Captain McMasters, and Colton, Caroline Austen and Ethel McMasters then get busy in Oilman's behalf, Caroline working with Colton, who is in love with her. and Ethel attempting to influence her father, but these two officers absolutely refuse to exercise any influence in Oilman's favor. Mr. Austen, Sr., then takes a hand in the game, but finds naval men a different proposition from politicians, and as a result Gilman is forced to leave the Academy. Mr. Austen uses his power and has Colton transferred to the command of a collier. Gilman Austen, however, grits his teeth and 'lists in the navy as an apprentice, and here we see him carried through all his training experiences. Colton being of an inventive turn of mind and realizing the weakness of the submarines is in the battery, invents a new battery. Archer hears of this and informs the Ruanian Ambassador, who offers the traitorous journalist almost any sum to secure these plans. Archer is prevented from securing them by Gilman Austen, who is now a full-fledged able seaman, serving under the name of Roger Brown. The Ambassador then determines upon a big coup. He directs Archer, who now is completely in his power, to have a Ruanian merchant ship lay a series of mines in the channel through which the warships must pass. Colton has been placed in command of the submarine flotilla, and Gilman Austen is on duty with the D-2. Through Caroline Austen, Colton learns of the plot, and as the ships are due to arrive that night, Colton takes command of the D-2, goes out and submerges his boat. title: E muet
description: Nanou's first true love story comes to an abrupt end. Rajwa treads carefully into a monogamous relationship. From 2008 to 2013, I accompanied them through their stories of passion and anguish, carrying with them their determination to arrive at the heart of things: to enter the hidden crevices of love, to uncover truth, all for the ever-elusive goal of understanding the essence of their own complex personalities. I entered their world to find answers to my own questions, to use their lives as my lens into discovering new forms of love. I stand at the intersection of friendship, love and seduction, unable to express the extent of my fascination for these women.

title: Miles E. Benedict
description: Miles E Benedict is a socially awkward teenager living in the crumbling district of Thatcher Heights. Miles begins to believe his life is a story being written by a sectioned schizophrenic with the same name. After finding a mysterious rucksack, Miles sole objective is simply to return it to its owner. However, Miles is soon thrust into an urban odyssey that sees him embroiled in a gangland feud and a love triangle that threatens to ignite all out war. As other characters begin to pursue the bag, Miles becomes convinced it is somehow linked to the fate of the district. The unlikely hero thus faces a race against time to return the bag and save his troubled world from destruction.

title: E-Team
description: When atrocities are committed in countries held hostage by ruthless dictators, Human Rights Watch sends in the E-Team (Emergencies Team), a collection of fiercely intelligent individuals hired to document war crimes and report them to the rest of the world. Within this volatile climate, filmmakers Ross Kauffman and Katy Chevigny take us to the frontline in Syria and Libya, where shrapnel, bullet holes, and unmarked graves provide mounting evidence of coordinated attacks conducted by Bashar al-Assad and the now-deceased Muammar Gaddafi. The crimes are rampant, random, and often undocumented, making E-Team's effort to get information out of the country and into the hands of media outlets and criminal courts all the more necessary.

title: e-Life
description: Computers, smart phones, and tablets are now a part of our daily lives. They have revolutionised the way we work, the way we communicate and the way we view the world. But what happens to our old phone when we upgrade? Where does our broken computer go after we throw it out? e-Life explores what happens to our electrical goods when we throw them away and exposes some unpleasant (and perhaps unknown) truths about the detrimental affects e-waste has on people's health, the environment and the economy. From consumers in the UK to the recyclers in the dumps of Ghana, the documentary will follow the journey of our e-waste. We will examine current manufacturing and disposal processes and also assess the burden the boom in electronic goods is placing on global resources. e-Life will be an objective portrayal of the problem of ewaste that documents the issue through carefully crafted cinematography.

title: The F Word
description: Robert Adanto's The F Word explores radical "4th wave" feminist performance through interviews with a new generation of feminist artists who use their bodies as subject matter. Because the female body continues to be politicized and policed, and because these artists delve into the fecund territory of female sexuality, self-objectification, and the female form as a site of resistance, many remain marginalized by the mainstream art world. Brooklyn-based Leah Schrager, well known for her performance practice, Naked Therapy, states, "As soon as you introduce a bit of sexiness or sexuality into an artwork it suddenly becomes questionable. Just because something elicits arousal or shows elements of sexiness does absolutely not make it not art." While some 4th wave artists, like Ann Hirsch and Kate Durbin, choose to analyze representations of female identity through digital media, others, like the radical, queer, transnational feminist art collective, Go! Push Pops, explore sexuality and gender in pop culture in the digital age. As feminist lecturer Kristen Sollee explains, 4th wavers, unlike their predecessors, "are not afraid to be 'girly', (or) to be hyper-feminine, or to wear a mini-skirt, to self-objectify" in the service of challenging patriarchal oppression or sexist ideals. Dr. Kathy Battista, Director of Contemporary Art at Sotheby's Institute of Art, New York and author of Re-negotiating the Body: Feminist Artists in 1970s London (IB Tauris, 2012), is an on-screen expert, as are noted art critic and curator, Nancy Princenthal, and feminist lecturer, Kristen Sollee.

title: Channel K
description: Half-hour series comprised of shorter segments, all lampooning TV programming, all intentionally in bad taste. Included "Bachelor Pad," where love guru Chad Randolph offered tips to single dudes on how to score chicks while on a budget; "Bikini Beat," where police badges come on skimpy bathing suits; "The Handy Dan Show," where an incompetent do-it-your-self expert showed the TV audience why to never do it yourself; "Life Styles of the Poor and Unkbown," a glamorous look at the not-so-glamorous lives of the under-privileged; "Too Hip," about a pair of Simease twins joined at the hip, one neat, one sloppy, who serve as police detectives; "6 and 1/2 Minutes," an investigative news magazine uncovering stories not big enough for prime time; and "Gomer Hiel, N.A.Z.I.," following the madcap adventures of an inept soldier in the World War II German army, among others.

title: F**k Buddies
description: F*ck Buddies, we see a middle-aged man on his couch drinking a glass of scotch, when his daughter walks in, sits next to him and takes a swig. "How's your sex life?," he asks her, matter-of-factly. They drone on about his date and her new friends and when the scene ends, she replies, "to answer your question, it's going pretty amazing." The effect the show is going for is cool and casual; just a father-daughter duo knocking back after a tough day at work. But then you watch it again and notice that there's nothing else in the scene. It doesn't lead to anything nor does it reveal something new about Jiah (Jikki Nair), the show's protagonist. And when you realize that the father doesn't get a second scene in the show, you sense a problem. The scene was written exclusively for its shock value. Which is ok if the show was trying to achieve something that was truly shocking. Even its central concept, about two friends "benefitting" with no strings attached, isn't exactly fresh. Other than the novelty of such a scenario being set in Chennai, it isn't rocket science for it to be explained. The contrived "Rules of F*ck Buddies" for instance. 'No going out', is one. 'No texting or calling' is another. Not only are these rules spelled out, but they are written up, framed and hung on Jay's (Jaytesh) bedroom wall. For people trying to keep things casual without labels, they seem extremely finicky about the rules. It's a show that tries too hard to be hip and progressive, but in the process, it reduces millennials to a bunch of alcoholic dimwits with nothing but sex on their minds. How about some texture while writing these characters? I know nothing about Jay, even after the whole show, other than he's a YouTuber (don't know what kind) and that he's a "wet dhummer"(someone who only smokes when he drinks). The same goes for Jiah. She's free and sexually liberated but does every single scene have to play out exactly the same way. It's hinted that she has some sort of a disease but it's neither serious enough to do some real damage nor is it used in such a way that it contributes to the screenplay. F*ck Buddies is a show so excited to be able to use the F word (and its many iterations) that it forgets that those words have to also make sense. And for all its progressive take on a modern relationship, one wishes they'd taken a ballsier stand. What's more to say about a show whose only intention is to make the audience go WTF.

title: Doctor K
description: Mysterious intern neurosurgeon Dr. Kang saves three young patients, even though the surgeries should not have saved the patients. Chief physician Dr. Lee becomes skeptical of the results so he sends video tapes of the surgery to America for analysis. Dr. Lee's niece, who is an anesthesiologist, Dr. Pyo Ji-Soo has strong feelings for Ji-Min, but keeps it to herself. One day, Oh Sae-Yun suffers from a brain tumor and is admitted to the hospital. Sae-Yun becomes involved in a hostage situation in the hospital, in which Dr. Ji-Min saves her. Since that time, Sae-Yun becomes interested in Dr. Kang. Sae-Yun follows Dr. Kang, who leaves the hospital late at night, and discovers Dr. Kang's secret. Sae-Yun, on the condition of keeping Dr. Kang's secret quiet, starts to date Dr. Kang. With the outcome of the tape analysis from America, Dr. Pyo discovers that Dr. Kang treats patients with his energy. The spirit of Dr. Kang's mother then asks Dr. Pyo to take care of her son.

title: Badla
description: Ramnagar is a simple beautiful village. Bharati Devi is a very honourable and respected Lady who loves her village. She is the chief of the local Panchayat of Ramnagar. She always backs the rights of the common people. Bharti devi lives in a very expanded family with all his sons and daughter. Sonaton is a very cruel and dishonest person who believes that Bharti Devi is responsible for his father's death. But everybody knows that was a mere accident. Sonaton conspires against her and tries to grab the property of Bharti Devialong with two of her eldest son who he manages to convice. But he knows that he has a hurdle in front of him called Arjun. Arjun is the brother of those two conspirators. He always works for the wellness and rights of the villagers, every single villager loves him and they believes him as their friend. On the other hand an urban girl Nanda came to Ramnagar and falls in love with Aarjun. But her mother wants her to marry Rudra who eventually is the brother of Sonatan. Then after lots of struggle Arjun became victorious over the cruel thought of Sonaton and won her love.

title: Sahara Pookkal
description: Sahara Pookkal shows the emotional and physical struggles endured in re-marriages. Step-parents clash with step-children. Yet, there is hope for Oviya and hopeless romantic Sangeeth but even love can be threatened by family ties.

title: Baby Shark's Big Show! S1-S3
description: It follows Baby Shark and his best friend, William the fish, as they journey on comedic adventures in their community of Carnivore Cove.

title: Raam
description: Pooja's rich uncles try to forcibly marry her off and Raam rescues her from this marriage. She falls in love with him, but her uncles don't approve of him. Now it is up to Raam to win their hearts.

title: Shine or Go Crazy
description: Wang So is the Prince of Goryeo who has a cursed fate. He had to get married with the Last Princess of Balhae, Shin Yool. She was born with the fate of becoming the light for another country. But because of this fate, she has to face death. Through their marriage life, Wang So and Shin Yool begin to grow closer and love each other.

title: Il mistero di Lovecraft - Road to L.
description: 1997: A student of folklore named Andrea Roberti hypothesizes the possible link between the horror literature of H.P. Lovecraft and the dark folk tales of the Po Delta, a mysterious and remote part of northern Italy. 2002: One of the directors of the film comes across a manuscript in Montecatini (Italy) which may have belonged to the American writer. This journal, dated 1926, describes travels in Italy through the Po Delta in search of inspiration in the form of local folk stories: the Filò Tales. 2004: A small, tough crew of international filmmakers is put together with the help of David, a New York actor, to make a documentary on the finding of the journal and on the links between Lovecraft and the Po Delta. If the manuscript really did belong to Lovecraft, it would be an extraordinary discovery. As soon as they begin, however, the filmmakers find that Andrea Roberti disappeared in mysterious circumstances many years before, his car found abandoned on the banks of the Po. The crew sets up its base in the town of Loreo - referred to simply as L. in the manuscript - as the author of the journal did. During their investigations the atmosphere of animosity and foreboding rises and they soon discover that strange and disturbing things have been happening in the area. Events that the locals are eager to keep secret. The film "Road to L." is the true account of what took place behind the scenes of the 11 day shoot, reporting how the failures and revelations experienced in L. came to resemble ever more a journey to... Hell. Did Lovecraft really come into contact with something sinister? Did Andrea Roberti stumble across something he wasn't meant to find? The documentary makers are stepping too far into the unknown...

description: Two Iranian-American female college students start an anonymous radio show about sex and virginity.

title: Tricks 'n' Tracks
description: The series of magic, music, tricks and tips. With Paul Zenon , Sally Gray , resident robots Arbie, Adam and Eve, and Russ Stevens performing some dazzling illusions.

title: N of 1
description: An electronic parts salesman in Toronto with no medical training conceives an idea that could revolutionize medicine. A young woman living in the American South faced with an incurable disease takes him up on it, and the two set out on an international odyssey to realize the possibility of a cure.

title: Lock 'n' Load
description: On the heels of the U.S. Supreme Court's recent ruling on the 2nd Amendment which reinforces every American's right to bear arms, this show is a fly on the wall at "The Shootist" gun store in Englewood, Colorado, where salesman Josh Ryan is always in full-on pitch mode - and the steady stream of customers never stops. And for every gun sold by this expert gunslinger at this family-owned store, there's a fascinating story and a fascinating buyer to tell it to him: the new parent who wants to protect his family; the teenager who's an expert hunter; the 30-something woman who feels a little more at ease with a revolver in her purse and the avid collector who simply has a fascination with guns of all kinds. There's even a shooting range in the basement to try out the merchandise before completing the sale.

title: Comics N Cocktails
description: The awkwardest duo around, from Awkward Conversations on Nerd Reactor, bring you Comics 'n Cocktails! Drinking booze and chatting about comic-books, superheroes, sci-fi, games, cult films, fantasy stories, magic, Star Wars, technology, Star Trek, cosplaying...and did we mention drinking booze? Anastasia 'Darth Boobs' Washington and Nathan 'Angry Baby' Lichtman sit down with nerdy guests and ask them the awkward questions you always wanted to... and did we mention there's drinking?

title: Business N' Debt
description: Business N' Debt follows our protagonist Micah as he battles against all odds to create the number one business.

title: Gav-n
description: When a genetically engineered weapon escapes containment from a top secret lab in Northern California a dark chess match begins amongst the members of the "Recovery team."

title: Love N Quarantine
description: Ben and Caroline have been married for years. Thrust into quarantine, their love gets put to the test.

title: Black n White [Assamese]
description: Siblings Rishi and Ritu lose their parents to COVID-19 and their home due to debt. Despite sincere efforts, their struggle to reclaim their home forms the heart of the narrative.

title: Ika N Okomi
description:
A house wife with a flippant mouth finds her life and marriage turned sour in a twinkle of an eye and when the necessary solution is taken, it amount to the unspeakable deeds of her confidant's past life. Find out more.
This movie features Odunlade Adekola, Folorunsho Adeola, Olaitan Sugar, Sunny Alli, Bukola Ojo, Kitan Bukola.

title: Rise 'n Shine Og
description: A show about an adorably hateful British woman living in Canada, trying to make her way through the world one miserable morning at a time. Rise 'n Shine Og is a comedic web series that chronicles the life of a lovable but crude 20 something slacker Brit living in Canada. Each webisode begins with our leading lady, Og, rising out of bed to meet the day. As is the case with all of us, some of Og's days start out on the right foot and some (most) do not, but regardless of how it begins she always manages to give the day an interesting spin... or does the day manage to give her a spin? Hmmm.

title: Dakota's Summer
description: Keith Carradine stars alongside a young, popular cast in this inspiring second chapter of the beloved Cowgirls 'N Angels story filled with heart, horses & high-reaching adventure.

title: Rock N' Roll
description: Story of a world renowned bassist Chandramauli trying to impress a singer named Daya by composing music.

title: O Amor que o Tempo Levou
description: Após oito anos com Tomas, Esme descobre que ele se casou em segredo com sua melhor amiga, Alessia, e tem um filho. description: A man facing several crisis in his life after losing his job and dealing with alcoholism decides to move to a farm, owned by his grandfather. Followed by his wife and child, the turmoil in his life increases in strange ways when the phantoms of two slaves comes to haunt the place seeking revenge on the man's forefathers.

title: O mestre e o Divino
description: Two filmmakers portray life in the village and in the mission of Sangradouro, Mato Grosso: Adalberto Heide, an eccentric German missionary, that soon after the contact with the Indians, in 1957, starts to film with his Super-8 camera; and Divino Tserewahu, a young Xavante filmmaker, that produces films for television and cinema festivals since the 90's. Shifting between complicity, competition, irony and affect, they give life to their historical records, revealing peculiar back-stages of indigenous catechizing in Brazil...

title: O gynaikas
description: When it comes to women, a rotund philanderer and managing director of his wife's family business is incapable of keeping himself under control, until one day, he crosses the line. Will his right-hand man always be there to save him?

title: O parthenokynigos
description: Insurance agent has to make sure there is no payout on chastity policy .

title: O Secunda
description: One second it's all it takes for lives to unravel, either you loose everything you hold dear or you get a new chance.

title: O Cavalariço Governa o Reino.
description: O herdeiro Roland Valen é forçado a se esconder após uma força misteriosa aniquilar sua família. Depois que a nobre Isabella o acolhe como cavalariço, ele passa dois anos ocultando as mortais habilidades de combate no polo que o fizeram temido em todo o reino. Mas, quando um implacável príncipe estrangeiro toma Isabella como alvo e ameaça a Casa Astra, Roland precisa sair das sombras e provar que o cavalariço que todos desprezavam é muito mais perigoso do que parece.

title: O emporakos
description: An honest medical student, who sells newspapers to make ends meet, falls in love with an affluent young woman with big, sad eyes. But, a shameless theft taints his immaculate reputation. Can an orphaned pedlar help him clear his name?

title: O fovos
description: Lei Bicheng uses the magic to bring Lv Guichen back to life. Xiao Zhou finds out the King's secret.

title: Quando o Tempo Sela o Amor
description: Um acordo desenrola a perseguição persistente de Kim Woo-jin por Lim Eun-ju. Dizem por aí que ele a ama até os ossos. Acontece que Eun-ju vivia à deriva após o término com seu antigo amor e aceitou o pedido de Woo-jin por impulso. Woo-jin abandona o sonho de ser médico e vira marido em casa, dedicando-se em segredo a desenvolver um medicamento para a alergia dela. Mas ela continua fria, só com Seo Min-ho no coração. Quando Seo Min-ho retorna, Woo-jin pede o divórcio.

title: O Gado Deu o Troco
description: Leonardo fez de Marcela a rainha de Wall Street, mas foi empurrado de um telhado por ela e Breno no dia do próprio casamento. Ao abrir os olhos novamente, Leonardo se vê de volta à época da faculdade. Tendo essa nova chance, ele jura viver apenas para si, chega de ser o gado da Marcela. Ele até encontra alguém novo: a jovem herdeira da Família Holanda...

title: O home e o can
description: Manuel, a man with intellectual disability, lives in a forgotten Galician village from which he does not remember ever having left until he decides to enter the city, a truly unknown territory for him.

title: O adelfos mou... o trohonomos
description: A traffic policeman, who is utterly devoted to service and duty, applies the traffic code with unyielding severity.

title: O Gorila
description: Afrânio is a retired voice actor. Lonely and tormented by memories of his childhood. In her small apartment, looking for a way to re-integrate into society.

title: O' Schwarzwald, O' Heimat
description: After a burn-out Karl spends time in his home region, the Black Forest. His car gets lost and is picked up by penniless magician Amadori who enjoys posing as wealthy entrepreneur Karl while Karl reunites with the love of his youth, Liesl.

title: O Trigo e o Joio
description: A sad and strong people living in the huge plains of Alentejo. Their endless struggle for bread, their nostalgic, bewitching songs and their daily toil to turn a dry, barren land into golden wheat fields.

title: O manavis
description: A 'road-movie' documentary about Pindus Mountains and their people.

title: O anipsios mou, o Manolis
description: After a misunderstanding, a simple man is considered to be the expected rich nephew of a family.

title: O aittitos
description: A childless Romani woman abducts the daughter of the prosecutor who imprisoned her. As she trains the child to do her evil bidding, the girl becomes a woman and soon finds herself accused of murder. Can a trainee solicitor clear her name?

title: Harry O
description: After being shot in the line of duty, Harry Orwell was forced to retire from the San Diego Police Department. To supplement his police pension, Harry runs a private detective agency out of his beach house.

title: O, schastlivchik!
description: Recently, Slavik has started to question the meaning of life and he has not found a positive or satisfactory answer. On the brink of suicide and about to end it all, Slavik is offered a chance to alter the outcome of his life.

title: O Sol - Caminhando Contra o Vento
description: Documentary telling the story of short-lived newspaper "O Sol", an alternative press item which hit the streets during the repressive years of military dictatorship in Brazil, more precisely in 1968. Created by poet Reynaldo Jardim, it had important collaborators in Brazilian cultural scene.

title: O LODI
description: A rich lady diagnosed of cancer, finds joy in a young man to kill her depressed state. But aside from her erupt cancer, something else wants her dead and very fast too.

description: A poor family lived in a small village far from the city. Batasa is the only girl in that family. She's dream is to marry a Raj Kumar, but it doesn't happen. On the other hand, Batasas father was always worried about his daughter marriage.

description: Can modern science explain the supernatural phenomenas? Is it possible that an innocent girl is loosing her mind and hurting herself? Davi, a psychologist, enters this family home to find out the truth.

title: O Corpo
description: Xavier, a pharmacist, lives peacefully in bigamy with his two women, Carmen and Beatriz, but the harmony breaks down when they find he has another lover, Monique, a nightclub dancer.

title: O Jogo
description: Auntie Nini dies, she leaves a big fortune, but to win it they'll have to play a game she left them, the relative who wins the game will own her fortune.

title: O Predileto
description: Based on the novel "Totônio Pacheco", written by João Alphonsus. At the time of the decadence of the great farms of Minas Gerais, Totônio is a symbol of the golden age of state farms: old and accustomed to having all his wills obeyed. However, after moving to his son's home because of his wife's death and the resulting loneliness, he realizes that he has lost his job as a boss and is struggling to regain his prestige by moving to a brothel.

title: O Diamante
description: Disagreements between brothers and marital infidelity are just some of the consequences that the discovery of a valuable diamond causes.

title: O Rebelde e o Estudioso
description: Maya Hayes é uma aluna nota dez com um objetivo: estudar muito, escapar do pai violento e nunca mais olhar para trás. Mas ao buscar refúgio em um estúdio de tatuagem após uma surra, ela esbarra no rebelde do Colégio Oakridge, Jude Sinclair. Logo, a aluna exemplar e o garoto rico com um passado sombrio viram colegas de classe. As madrugadas viram segredos compartilhados, e os insultos dão lugar à compreensão. Aos poucos, enxergam além de suas armaduras e descobrem algo verdadeiro. Juntos, fazem um pacto: libertar-se, lutar e destruir tudo o que tenta derrubá-los.

title: O Psyllos
description: "O Psyllos" (The Flea) is the title of a newspaper, published by a 12-year-old student, Elias, who lives in a small village on highland Olympia. His dream and its pursuit are thriftily but beautifully illustrated, along with the rural life of the '60s in Greece.

title: O Amuleto
description: Moçambique beach in Florianópolis, have a lot of unsolved murders cases. One day, Diana, Alex, Paulinho and Marcinha went to a party in the forest. In the next day, three teenagers are found death. Diana is the only survivor, but she doesn't remember what happen. The only thing that will help to solve the case is the videos recorded with their cell phones.

title: Infierno o Paraíso
description: Addiction becomes like a shadow. You know?

title: O Barão
description: The story of a vampire who terrorized the inhabitants of a mountainous region.

title: O apithanos
description: Thomas, the owner of an electrical appliances store, is having business problems due to his short-fuse temper and bad luck.

title: O Coro
description: The award-winning drama O CORO (the chorus), directed by Werner Schumann, follows the lives of four characters rehearsing with the Symphony Orchestra. Set in the southern Brazilian city of Curitiba, O CORO tells the story of the characters' lives, and with subtlety and poetry, depicts their inner conflicts and how art has brought them together and may even redeem them.

title: Asha-o-Bhalobasha
description: Thakur family had a reputation of their kind heart and helpfulness. Bijoy and his sister was the only living member of the family. Bijoy was a popular figure of that area for his helpful and supportive attitude. Rupa a loving girl of the same area loved Bijoy. Bilas Dutta a selfish and clever businessman tried to exploit the villagers with his different tricks and strategies. Local police also helped Bilas in his business. Once Bilas made a conspiracy against Bijoy and put him in jail. After that he created such a situation so that Bijoy's only sister committed suicide. After few years, Bijoy came out from jail and came to know everything from his friends. At the same time, Bilas made another false allegation against Bijoy and tried to put him in jail but this time Bijoy escaped cleverly. After a long struggle, Bijoy managed to get some clue and at last Bijoy took the revenge against Bilas Dutta and his gang.

title: The O-Zone
description: A weekly prime-time BBC2 TV pop magazine. With interviews, videos and live performances from UK and US chart topping acts.

description:
Oooh lala-van na lavan ang pitik ng bewang nina Baby Dolls Arianne, Chloe, Johaira, Juby, Jelai, Eriel, and Ina. To welcome their era as an official P-Pop group at kauna-unahang Hype Group ng bayan, ginanap ang Baby Dolls Day.

Present ang mga social media personalities, Kapamilya at Kapuso "PBB" ex-housemates, beauty queens, P-Pop groups, "Tawag Ng Tanghalan" alumni, "Showtime Online U" hosts, at All-Star Games Basketball at Volleyball Team para makigiling.

Pagkatapos ng Baby Dolls Day celebration, bumida naman ang beki na may talak para sa buong nation. Meet CY ng Quezon City, Fema Braganza ng Pangasinan, at BRIGIT ng Laguna, ang mga talakera na sumubok masungkit ang korona sa Miss Q and A.

Minsan ang talak, may pagka-harsh, parang comment ni Ogie Alcasid, na hindi inurungan sa puksaan si Vhong Navarro. Kaya ang ilong ni Vhong, napuruhan sa laitan!

Naloka naman ang Madlang People sa sagot ng mga kandidata sa unang tanong sa Tumpak Ganern tungkol sa karakter sa Noli Me Tangere na sinasabing ama ni Maria Clara. Ang sagot ni BRIGIT, "Nutridamus!" Kaya biro ni Vice Ganda, kapatid ba 'yan ni Nutri Bun?

Sina Fema at CY ang umabante sa next round ng chukchakan, ang Wit Lang. Pagkatapos ng talakan, ang very 'pulchritudinous', sabi ni Brent Manalo, na si CY ang kinoronahan bilang Miss Q and A Reyna Talak-Era of the day.

Pumadyak ang swerte at good vibes para sa mga pedicab driver na sumalang sa Laro Laro Pick game arena.

Nakaka-touch ang pagiging solid Showtimer ni Tatay Doms, na may iniabot pang liham ng pasasalamat para kay Vice Ganda at sa buong "It's Showtime" family. Pero, si Kim Chiu, nagtampo, dahil wala ang pangalan niya sa sulat na ito.

Pagkatapos ng aktingan, iisa lang ang naka-survive sa laro! Ito ay si Mavin, na kahit mahirap man ang buhay ay nananatiling masayahin. Kapang P300k ang napasakanya, babawi siya sa magulang niya. Pero sapat nang pambawi ang P40,000 na Li-Pot offer kaya dito na siya sa siguradong uuwi siyang panalo.

title: Jhong, Vhong at Kim, nagpagalingan ng joke
description:
Kung may isang alamat na hindi nakakasawang balik-balikan, ito 'yung alamat na masarap panoorin habang sila'y kumakanta at nagsasayawan. None other than P-Pop group, ALAMAT, na nagbabalik ang grupo sa 'It's Showtime' studio para i-perform ang Luzviminda,

Walang basaan dito pero bubumuhos ang swerte at good vibes kasama ang mga taga-San Juan City (na kilala sa 'Wattah Wattah' Festival) sa 'Laro Laro Pick' game arena.

Naglaro rin sina Teddy Corpuz, Darren Espanto, Jackie Gonzaga at Ryan Bang. Si Jackie lang ang nakatawid sa 'You Gotta Lyric,' kung saan tama naman ang sagot niya, pero pabirong idineklarang "wrong" ni Jhong Hilario dahil sintunado. To the rescue naman si Darren para itama ang tono! Dackie moment na ‘to!

Samantala, na-touch ang Showtime hosts sa kuwento ng buhay ni Wo, isang delivery rider na laki sa lolo. Habang itinataguyod ang sariling pamilya, gusto rin niyang maibalik ang sakripisyo ng lolong nagpalaki sa kanya. Samantala, 'extra' ang banter nina Kim Chiu at Jhong na nauwi pa nga sa dilatan ng mga mata. At syempre, kanya-kanya silang entry ng jokes tungkol sa pangalan ni Wo!

Very good din si Tate, ang tricycle driver na sweet lover kay misis, at may malasakit din sa kapwa. Minsan na niyang pinatunayan ang kabutihan nang ibalik ang gamit na naiwan ng pasahero. Kaya ang madlang girls sa studio, na-in love kay Tate! 'Yun nga lang, si misis, umapela, "Sorry po, married na!"

Luck ay na-attract ni Margo, ang hairstylist na 'di nauubusan ng kuwento. Pati tungkol kina Ogie Alcasid at Anne Curtis, meron siyang 'chismis.' At shoutout sa mga ex niya, hanggang tingin na lang daw kayo sa kan'yang ganda! Umabot sa P35,000 ang Li-Pot offer, na tinanggap ni Margo. Tama ang pinili ate n'yo dahil nang subukan niya ang P350k Pot question, akala niya'y 'simple' lang pero hindi pala niya alam ang kasagutan.

It's time for Region 1 to shine sa second week ng ika-10 taon ng "Tawag Ng Tanghalan."

Ang unang kalahok ay mula Laoag City, si Jeanel Silvestre, na nagpamalas ng husay sa entablado, singing Juan Karlos ‘JK’ Labajo's "Demonyo." Katulad ng idol na si JK, nagsusulat din ng kanta si Jeanel, na bet 'piratahin' ni Ogie nang magustuhan ang sample ng self-composition nito. Speaking of songwriting, may tip si Ogie tungkol d'yan.

Ang awit daw ay hinuhugot sa sariling kuwento, parang si Louie Ocampo, na binuo ang "Tell Me" mula sa sariling karanasan. Binalikan din ng 'Showtime' family ang iba pang iconic songs na nilikha ng maestro. Proud din si Ogie dahil komposisyon ng kanyang kaibigan

ang napiling bagong theme song ng isang airline. Chika niya, isa siya sa napakaraming tinalo ni Sir Louie sa paggawa ng theme song na 'to.

Samantala, napabilib ni Jeanel sina hurado Jonathan Manalo, Bituin Escalante, at Maestro Louie. Para sa kanila, strength ni Jeanel ang pagiging chill nito, at ang magandang tone.

Mula Pangasinan, lumuwas si Shekinah Barbiran to chase her dream sa tanghalan. "Ikaw Ay Ako" ni Klarisse De Guzman ang napili niyang sandata sa laban ng bosesan. At 15, 'beterano' na siya sa pagsali ng contests. Dahil seasoned kontesera, nakita ng hurados ang pagiging relaxed niya.

Nagustuhan ng hurados ang dalawang nagtanghal pero isa lang ang aabante sa susunod na round, at ito ay si Jeanel na nakakuha ng markang 91% laban sa 89.3% ni Shekinah.

title: Miss Q&A: Lucia, pagod nang magpanggap sa male pageants?
description:
Big pasabog ang naging announcement ni Bianca Gonzalez sa August 14 episode ng "It's Showtime." Kasama ang "Pinoy Big Brother" co-hosts na sina Gabbi Garcia at Kim Chiu, ibinalita ni Bianca ang muling pagbubukas ng Bahay ni Kuya sa pinakabagong "PBB Collab 3.0." 

To mark this new and exciting "PBB" era, nakisaya ang ilan sa mga ex-housemates. From Bahay Ni Kuya to the "It's Showtime" stage, muling nagsama-sama sa isang song and dance prod number sina “PBB Collab” ex-housemates AC Bonifacio, Klarisse De Guzman, Will Ashley, at Mika Salamanca, with Kabataang Pinoy Lella Ford, Joaquin Arce, Marco Masa, at Ashley Sarmiento na mula naman sa "PBB Collab 2.0."

Sa queendom ng talakan, isa lang ang pwedeng umangat. Pero sa araw na 'to, tatlong reyna ang nagharap-harap. Ibinuhos nina Sta. Lucia Joaquin Bordado, Miukie, at CK Alcaraz Zarfl ang wit at talak na di paaawat para korona ay sa kanila tumapat. 

Nakaka-reyna rin ang mga kuwento at inspirasyon na ibinahagi nila. Si Candidate 1, stop na sa pagpapanggap, kay from male pageants, Miss Q&A naman ang sinubukan upang maipakita ang totoong sarili. 

School teacher at dating principal naman si Candidate 2. Pero ano nga ba ang mga diskriminasyon na hinarap niya sa karera? At si Candidate 3, naghahanap ng kalinga ng ama. Nanawagan siya sa amang German, hoping na magkita sila soon sa unang pagkakataon.
Sina Miukie at CK ang nag-face off sa Wit Lang round. First time naman ni Bianca Gonzalez na umupo bilang hurado. 

Ang mga muscles nila ay kaflex-flex! Mag-work out din kaya ang swerte para sa mga gym instructors ng Metro Manila.

Si player Nad ang patunay na palaging may second chance ang taong determinadong mapaganda ang buhay. Ang dating number one sa inuman, gym na ang paboritong tambayan. 

Katulad sa real life, nabigyan din si Nad ng second chance sa laro. Matapos ma-eliminate ang lahat ngg players, bumunot ng isang sasalang sa jackpot round, at pangalan ni Nad ang nabunot.

title: Project Q: War, Peace and Quantum Mechanics
description: Project Q is an intellectual travelogue that travels from Sydney to Berlin, Brussels, Copenhagen, Singapore, Ann Arbor, Silicon Valley, Shanghai, New Delhi, Yerevan and elsewhere, tracking the origins, evolution and potential convergence of quantum science, technology and geopolitics. The key principles of quantum mechanics - complementarity, uncertainty, superposition, entanglement and the wave function - act as signposts for the many worlds of quantum. Project Q is a geopolitical thriller. Big Tech vies for 'quantum supremacy', whereby a quantum computer outperforms the fastest digital supercomputer. Major powers compete in a quest for 'quantum hegemony'. Universities pursue laboratory breakthroughs as governments impose - under the guise of thwarting espionage, hacking and intellectual property theft - increasingly restrictive regulations that thwart international scientific collaboration and ratchet up nationalist rivalries. Project Q is a cautionary tale. As superpowers, rising states, universities, corporations and entrepreneurs compete for in a global race for big strategic and commercial payoffs, secrecy becomes the norm and ethics the exception in the quantum race. Little attention is being paid to privacy risks, asymmetries of power and existential threats that are likely by-products of a new quantum revolution. Project Q digs into the archives, asks critical questions, and exposes the dark side of a quantum future.

title: Miss Q&A Havana
description:
Kasama natin for today's video ang bandang The Red Strings, na very inspired sa paggawa ng nakaka-good vibes na musika. Sa mga taong naghahanap ng organic encounter, at para sa lahat, ang kanta nilang "Nasa Ulap."

Matatapos na ang June, pero hindi ang wit at tawanan sa "Miss Q and A." Sina Kishan Garcia ng Makati, Rhain Bayonon ng Manila, at Havana Alawi ng Quezon City ang nagPAKsiklabn sa 'chukchakan' today.

Para kay Kishan, her tattoos are part of her charm at kagandahan. Eh, kung may bagay na tattoo kay Havana, ano kaya ito? May naisip na si Vice Ganda! Pwedeng kulayan daw ng blue si Havana tapos ‘avatar’ ang kalalabasan. 'Amats' nga ni Meme ang beki na may kakaibang 'hugis' ang tainga, at ang boses ay tunog galing ibang planeta. Biro ni Meme, parang nagtatawag ng alien si Havana.

With grace and substance ang talakan nina Kishan at Rhaine sa Wit Lang. Si Kishan, nabunot ang tanong na, "Ilang oras ang dapat itulog ng jowa mong napagod na sayo?" Sagot niya, hindi dapat makatulog sa kaiisip sa kan'ya ang ex-jowa.

Mga kwentong nakakatuwa at may hati na inspirasyon at pag-asa ang pasalubong ng mga taga-Malanday, Marikina sa Laro Laro Pick game arena. Nakakuwentuhan nina Vice Ganda, Kim Chiu at Amy Perez ang isang tricycle driver, na pakiramdam ay wala ng pag-asa ang mga pangarap niya. Kaya ang payo nila, maniwala! Sabi nga ni Kim, "The world is big and so are your dreams."

Big naman ang aktingan sa inaabangan na 'You Gotta Lyric' round. Si Teddy Corpuz, tiklop sa mga lalaking malaki ang katawan. Si Jackie Gonzaga, tiklop naman sa paalala ni Ion Perez na taken na siya.

It must be the curly hair na naghatid ng swerte kay Bert, na sinugalan ang P100,000 POT money. Ano nga ba ang halamang pinakamabilis tumubo ayon sa Guinness World Records?

title: Dear Mister Moon
description: When two stepsisters - 13-year-old Sigrid and 7-year-old Saara - meet each other for the first time, it will turn out that their grandmother has been taken to a retirement home. The girls make up their minds to steal grandma from the home and hide her in an attic-room where they could be all together. Everything goes unexpectedly well until drunkards, hoodlums and blackmailers interfere and the girls have to know exactly what they are doing in order to escape the gang.

title: Miss Q&A candidate, may kakaibang dictionary!
description:
Mula sa iconic na “Jumbo Hotdog” at “Sana Mama” na minsang nagpaindak sa buong nation, nagbabalik to flex their muscles and new single ang grupong Masculados. Grateful ang grupo na makabalik at mabigyan ng pagkakataong ipagpatuloy ang kanilang musika.

Hindi lang ganda ang puhunan, dapat may wit na panlaban. Dahil bawat tanong, kailangang may sagot na papalakpakan ng buong bayan. Kaya naghanda ng matitinding linyahan ang mga Miss Q and A candidates na nagharapan.

Ready magbigay ng tutorial sa ganda at talino ang online tutor na si Precious Alden Ganaden, habang mula pageant coaching ay siya naman ngayon ang sasabak sa sariling laban, si MJ Apin Salada. Naaliw naman ang Madlang People, pati na si Vice Ganda, sa kakaibang dictionary ni Ivanach.

Sa second round na Wit Lang, sina MJ at Ivanach ang nagharap. Sinubok si Ivanach sa tanong na, “Kung lechon ka, mao-offend ka ba kung balat lang ang habol sa ’yo samantalang full package ka naman?” Si MJ naman, napaisip kunngmagtatampo ba ang king cobra kung hindi siya ang king of the jungle.

Ayusin ang display at siguraduhing kumpleto ang stocks at siguruhing available ang swerte. Mula sa pag-aasikaso ng mga produktong mabenta, saglit munang iniwan ng mga merchandisers mula NCR ang kanilang puwesto para subukang i-checkout ang POT money sa “Laro Laro Pick."

Kinilala ng hosts si player Frank, ang loving hubby and addy na baon sa utang. Kaya naman si Tyang Amy Perez, to the rescue bitbit ang payo niyang wais. Love life naman ang usapan nang kanilang lapitan si pplayer Yong, na dinamayan ng hosts matapos malamang hiwalay na sila ng kanyang girlfriend.

Kay Frank talaga napunta ang swerte dahil siya ang umabot sa Jackpot Round! Pero imbes na isugal ang lahat para sa ₱450,000 POT, pinili niyang tanggapin ang ₱35,000 Li-Pot offer para may siguradong maipambayad sa kanyang maraming utang.

title: SexBomb Jopay, sumali sa Miss Q&A?!
description:
Napahugot ang madlang people sa pagbisita ng bandang Mayonnaise at sa kanilang performance ng “Bakit, Pt. 2.” 'Nag-spread' din sila ng good vibes nang makisabay sa trending “Meme” dance challenge!

Ang kandidata na mabagal sa pindutan at waley sa talakan, siya naman ang uuwing luhaan. Buti na lang palaban at ginalingan nina "Miss Q and A" JC Ibale, Anxji Rose, at Bon Joey Trinidad.

Habang kinikilala ng hosts ang tatlong ladies, pagandahan din sila ng mga joke entries. Ang starting lineup ay sina Vice Ganda, Jhong Hilario, at Vhong Navarro, pero 'di nagtagal, si Vhong ang unang napatalsik dahil sa joke niyang not-so matinik. First substitution of the day!

Chance na rin ito ng ibang hosts na sumabak sa "Miss Q and A." Maya-maya pa, nasubok naman ang husay ni Teddy Corpuz. Pero hindi pa man nagsisimula ang banter, parang may "issue" detected agad. Biro ni Meme, huwag gumigilid-glid si Teddy dahil baka magreklamo ito sa blocking, tapos ang netizens umariba na naman sa bashing.

Back to the pageant, unang pumaslak sa next round si JC, habang sina Anxji at Bon Joey ay nagbangayan tungkol sa "eulogy." Kaloka, mga teh! Pero pagkatapos ng mahabang diskusyon, si Bon Joey ang umabante sa Wit Lang at tumalak sa harap ng buong nation.

Kapag swerte ang bumagsak, huwag manghihina. Baka jackpot ang naghihintay sa players mula Marikina! POT money kaya ay maiuuwi nila?

Mukhang may dalang swerte talaga kapag ikaw ang first interviewee, dahil madalas, sa jackpot round, sila rin ang umaabante. Araw talaga ito ni Emon dahil siya ang naglaro sa POT o Li-POT round.

title: Ahtisa, pinuri ang Miss Q&A segment
description:
Major throwback feels ang hatid ni New Zealand singer-songwriter na si Bic Runga sa “It’s Showtime” nang kantahin niya ang kanyang hit na “Sway," na bahagi na ng playlist ng maraming Pinoy, lalo na noong ’90s at early 2000s.

Huwag ubusin ang wit, dapat laging may reserba lalo na kung sa 'Miss Q and A' ka eeksena. Pak na pak na palakpakan ang sumalubong kina Mariposa Jem Lacsina, Affarah Deur, at Curevedilol Filipinas Galore as they walked the runway and left the crowd wanting more.

Dahil kakaiba mga pangalan ng mga kandidata, na-curious si Vice Ganda at inalam ang kuwento sa likod ng mga ito. Kung ang "It's Showtime" family naman ang papipiliin, ano ng gusto nilang maging 'beki' name? Back to the pageant, hindi tumalab ang full pack makeup ni Curevedilol sa pabilisan sa pagpindot at pagsagot. Siya ang unang umuwing lotlot. Sina Mariposa at Affarah naman ang nag-face off sa Wit Lang.

Mga bituin at diskarte ang kanilang gamay para sumakses sa buhay. Swerte ay maningning, kaya POT money ang goal sungkitin ng madlang players mula Tala, Caloocan na sumabak sa Laro Laro Pick.

Agaw-eksena ang galawan ni player Rian. Kung twerking lang naman kasi ang labanan, si Jackie Gonzaga ay wit niya uurungan. Na-shookt ang everybody, lalo na si Vice Ganda, sa wild moves ni Rian sa dance floor. Para bang makabagong bunot ang peg!

Kinaaliwan naman ni Meme Vice si Gara, isa labandera, dahil super natural lang ng cuteness at charisma nito. Pero naging emotional si Gara nang mapag-usapan ang kanyang asawa. Na-touch si Meme sa kuwento, kaya may pakimkim na agad itong abuinaldo bago pa man dumating ang Pasko.

Kay Gara nga kumapit ang swerte. Sa jackpot round, siya ang umabante! Nadoble pa ang kanyang aguinaldo dahil umuwi siyang may tatlumpung libong piso, matapos tanggapin ang Li-Pot offer.
